rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=72, recon_eta=2.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=72, train_n=0, rationale=iter-9 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon -- TUNE THE DPS GUIDANCE GAIN at the CG-DC working point (untried axis; NFE is now at its val_n budget floor). ONE KNOB: recon_eta (DPS soft-guidance gain, the adaptive-weight scalar zeta_t=eta/||resid|| in Chung 2023 eq.12) 5.0 -> 2.0. BASE = iter-8 (BEST SSIM 0.8784): recon_sample_steps=72, recon_dc_solver=cg, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false, val_n=72 ALL UNCHANGED. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (200 train slices, NO retrain). WHY eta IS THE RIGHT KNOB NOW: the NFE lever (recon_sample_steps) was the SSIM climber across iters 6-8 (CG-DC 0.8241 @T40 -> 0.8711 @T56 -> 0.8784 @T72) but is at DIMINISHING returns (+0.047 then +0.0073) AND at its budget floor -- T=72 already needs val_n=72, and the next NFE step T->90 would push val_n below the ~60 representative-metric floor. eta has NEVER been tuned WITH hard-CG active: iters 1-2 moved eta (30->5) on the PURE-SOFT path (recon_dcstep_every=0) BEFORE the CG-DC A-fix existed, where the soft DPS gradient was the ONLY data-fidelity term. Since iter-6 the CG projection (n_cg=3 Gauss-Newton solve of AtA x = At y every 5 steps, relax=1.0 full hard projection) is the DOMINANT fidelity backstop, so the eta=5 soft gradient -- a leftover sized for the no-CG regime -- is likely OVER-DRIVING and double-counting the measurements, fighting the CG projection and leaving residual texture that costs SSIM. eta is a free scalar on the existing per-step gradient: ZERO extra forward/backward/projector calls, so val_n stays 72 (no NFE trade). TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 0.3688; iter-2 eta30->5 0.3960 (best soft); iter-3 T25->32 0.3869; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC 0.0553 (collapse); iter-5 T->40 soft 0.3709; iter-6 recon_dc_solver=cg CG-DC 0.8241/PSNR27.15 (A-fix); iter-7 T40->56 0.8711/PSNR29.82; iter-8 T56->72 0.8784/PSNR30.59 (BEST). LIMITER: hr regime-bounded at 0 on DENSE 2304-view rebinned Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete); NFE at the val_n budget floor; the eta/guidance gain is the last untried in-budget SSIM axis at the CG-DC working point. HYPOTHESIS: with hard-CG now owning data fidelity, the eta=5 soft DPS gradient is too aggressive and double-counts the measurements; lowering eta 5->2 lets the CG projection dominate and the soft term only nudge, reducing residual texture and lifting SSIM modestly above iter-8 0.8784 -- predicted 0.878-0.885, hr STAYS 0 (regime-bound). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8784 (flat-or-down vs iter-8) at eta=2, the eta/guidance lever is EXHAUSTED on the CG-DC path (eta inert once hard-CG is active) AND NFE is at its budget floor -> both in-budget SSIM levers are spent; file it, unconstrained best stays iter-8 (SSIM 0.8784, hr 0), and the only remaining lever is the DEFERRED v5 EMA DDPM prior retrain (full train pool + EMA + DPS-recon selection). BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall, val=72 evenly-spaced L277): eta adds ZERO compute -- iter-8 ran 1051.6s at T=72/val_n=72 = 14.605 s/slice; iter-9 same T=72/val_n=72 -> 72*14.605 = 1052s = 17.5 min < 1200s (~148s headroom). val_n=72 held above the ~60 floor. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False), recon_dc_solver=cg. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain).
